origin.guaxi-origin.guaxi.name: Guaxi
origin.guaxi-origin.guaxi.description: Small creatures known for their chaotic and silly nature. Inspired by the Guaxis from §5Lightwuz's community.
power.guaxi-origin.resilient_stomach.des: You have a stronger stomach than humans, allowing you to eat rotten food without side effects.
power.guaxi-origin.fast_metabolism.name: Faster Metabolism
power.guaxi-origin.fast_metabolism.descr: You need to eat more to keep yourself nourished.
power.guaxi-origin.fishing_luck.name: Fishing Luck
power.guaxi-origin.fishing_luck.descript: Fishing with a rod grants you the Luck effect.
power.guaxi-origin.great_swimmer.name: Great Swimmer
power.guaxi-origin.light_body.name: Light Body
power.guaxi-origin.light_body.descriptio: Your small body makes difficult to use heavy armor and tools.
power.guaxi-origin.limited_climbing.name: Limited Climbing
power.guaxi-origin.limited_climbing.desc: You can climb blocks that do not have a smooth surface.
power.guaxi-origin.momentum.name: Momentum
power.guaxi-origin.momentum.description: You gradually become faster while sprinting. After building enough momentum, your attack damage starts increasing. Momentum does not build while swimming, and is lost when you hit an entity.
power.guaxi-origin.noodling.name: Noodling
power.guaxi-origin.noodling.description: While sneaking and looking at the water, you can fish with your bare hands.
power.guaxi-origin.small_size.name: Small Size
power.guaxi-origin.small_size.descriptio: Your small body gives you less health.
